literal: Whispering in the ear and shared laughter, having suppressed, behaving, in the presence of abundant great people.
translation: In the presence of great rulers, one must conduct oneself by avoiding whispering in another's ear and sharing private smiles.
modern: அறிவு ஒழுக்கங்களில் சிறந்த பெரியவர்களின் முன்னிலையில், மற்றொருவர் காதில் இரகசியம் பேசுவதையும், அவருடன் சேர்ந்து சிரிப்பதையும் தவிர்த்து நடக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the essential etiquette to be observed when in the presence of rulers or highly placed individuals. Whispering into another person's ear and sharing private smiles or laughter are actions that can breed suspicion, appearing as if one is gossiping or mocking the ruler. To prevent such misunderstandings, a subordinate must completely suppress these habits. Conducting oneself with such restraint in their presence preserves dignity and fosters mutual trust.
